planets.name: K2-33 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-33 with a 5.42-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-33 b was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-33. Its orbit and size follow Mann et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname MANN_ET_AL__2016): disc_year 2016, disc_facility K2, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 5.424865, pl_radj 0.44963868, pl_bmassj 3.7

quotes.title: K2-33
quotes.card: It is known to host one planet, a super-Neptune, named K2-33b.
quotes.introduction: It is also notable for its young age.
